candidates.title: Fix payment status badge class names
candidates.externalDependencyRisk: none — pure string template fix, no external service involved
candidates.reason: getStripePaymentStatusColor builds class names as `${bg}-red` and `${bg}-yellow` where bg is already 'bg-600', producing 'bg-600-red' and 'bg-600-yellow' — words in the wrong order, classes that do not exist in Tailwind. Only the 'succeeded' branch uses the correct pattern `bg-green-${shade}`. Canceled and processing badges therefore render with no background colour. The fix is one file, provable without secrets, and the broken pattern is directly visible in source.

evidence.note: Line 38: const bg = `bg-${shade}` builds 'bg-600'. Lines 41-42: [`${bg}-red`] and [`${bg}-yellow`] become 'bg-600-red' / 'bg-600-yellow' — invalid Tailwind classes
Line 49: [`bg-green-${shade}`] correctly produces 'bg-green-600' — establishes the correct pattern the other branches must follow
